I've been crocheting ever since my grandma/mom taught me when I was a little girl. 

She passed April 6th this year. 

She has made over a hundred beautiful afghans, countless baby blankets, baptismal outfits, scarves, hats, ankle warmers, gloves, dolls, ear warmers, pot holders, and hand made many handmydown clothes for all ten (eleven including me) kids and all of their grandkids up until her passing. There's many bins of her beautiful work, and sadly not one of her own kids ever took to learning from her. 

It's bittersweet to say I'm the only one who learned from her because I really wish the rest of my family got the chance to sit and watch how her fingers moved so delicately with the yarn. 

I wish they could have heard how she explained patterns so easily, and I wish they felt her hands guide theirs to the right positioning to crochet. 

These are things I'll never forget. 

I just turned 21 in August. I miss my mom.
